text: Memory stops at the moment of evacuation. Power is out beyond the hatch. Only a few bundles of dry wood remain in the corner.
The metal hatch pushes open from within. Each breath turns to white mist.
You wake in a frost-covered workshop. A fire, some provisions, and a handful of people gathered around you are all you have.
